purpose: Document first-party Ratlam/Madhya Pradesh registry discovery, public route attempts, safe-field limits, and uncertainty.
assessment: Official Ratlam District Administration evidence establishes local land-record service custody and identifies Ratlam GIS. MP Bhulekh is the state land-record/Naksha route and DILRMP reports Ratlam cadastral-map status. No safe anonymous ID-plus-complete-polygon response was obtained.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is supported by the official Ratlam District Administration land-record page, which names the Ratlam Lok Seva Kendra/Tehsildar location and describes district spatial and non-spatial land records and Naksha. This is local service custody evidence only; it is not source integration, ownership evidence, or proof of citywide parcel availability.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Ratlam district page says land records for 1089 villages, spatial and non-spatial, are available through the MP land-record service and lists Naksha output; it identifies the Lok Seva Kendra, Office of the Tehsildar, Ratlam.
Official English Ratlam GIS page links the district GIS portal and describes roads, utilities, land use, government assets and public infrastructure; it does not document a parcel feature API.
Official Hindi Ratlam GIS page confirms the same district GIS description and portal link.

Official state land-record portal identified by the Ratlam district page/search; direct retrieval timed out in this bounded pass, so its current JavaScript/configuration and feature schema were not verified.
Official Government of India DILRMP Ratlam status route exposes cadastral-map, georeferencing, RoR-linking and ULPIN status headings; it is progress evidence, not a parcel feature endpoint.
Official Madhya Pradesh town-planning page lists Ratlam khasra land-use/development-plan maps; these are planning-map materials, not a safe anonymous native parcel API.
